## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RecordedRaceListenerService — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/sync/RecordedRaceListenerService.kt

## Trigger

A message received on the Wearable Data Layer, in onMessageReceived — nothing observes it: the call is unguarded and the coroutine it launches carries no exception handler.

## Today

Across the project, only `ExerciseSessionSystemImpl.startExerciseSession` and
`HrHistoryReaderImpl.bpmValuesOverLast12Months` turn a failure into a value —
seven `catch` blocks total, all in `:app-wear`/`:app-phone` platform adapters,
none in `:core-domain` or `:core-data`, and no `runCatching` anywhere.

`RecordedRaceListenerService.onMessageReceived` calls
`PayloadCodec.decodeRecordedRace(event.data)` directly: a malformed or
version-mismatched payload throws inside `ObjectInputStream.readObject`
(`PayloadCodec.kt`, `toObject`) and the exception propagates straight out of
`onMessageReceived`, which no caller guards. The same call then launches
`serviceScope.launch { ackTransport.send(...) }`; `serviceScope` is
`CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)` with no
`CoroutineExceptionHandler`, so a failure inside that launch reaches the
default uncaught-exception handler and takes the process down.

The identical pair of problems repeats at `ProfileSyncListenerService`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sync/ProfileSyncListenerService.kt):
`PayloadCodec.decodeProfileSync(event.data)` is unguarded, and its
`serviceScope` (same construction, no handler) wraps
`profileSyncPushService.applyIncoming(...)`.

Room boundaries are unguarded the same way. `RaceRepositoryImpl`
(core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/race/RaceRepositoryImpl.kt)
and `ProfileRepositoryImpl`
(core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/profile/ProfileRepositoryImpl.kt)
implement `RaceRepository`/`ProfileRepository`, both declared with
`Result<T>` return types, but every function calls `raceDao`/`profileDao`
directly with no `try`/`catch`: `Result.failure` is only ever built from a
domain validation (`NoSuchElementException`, `IllegalArgumentException`,
`IndexOutOfBoundsException`), never from a caught Room exception. A Room
failure (e.g. an `SQLiteException`) propagates through a function whose
signature promises a `Result`. `RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.kt)
carries the same gap indirectly: `markSegment` calls
`profileRepository.observe().first()` inside `runBlocking`, unguarded, so a
Room failure surfacing through the Room-backed `ProfileRepositoryImpl` takes
down `markSegment` — the mark-a-segment path — with it.

No flow collection is guarded either. Seven `collect` sites carry no
`.catch`: `HomeViewModel.kt` (`observeReference`, `profileRepository.observe()`,
`recordedRaceSyncService.observe()`, `linkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished()`),
`PreparationViewModel.kt` (`observeReference`), `WatchHistoryViewModel.kt`
(`watchHistoryStore.observe()`), `WaitingForPhoneViewModel.kt`
(`profileRepository.observe()`) — all in `:app-wear`. The two collectors of
the link-state flow — `HomeViewModel.kt:79` and
`app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/profile/ProfileViewModel.kt:113`,
both against `LinkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished()`
(core-sync/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/sync/link/LinkStateMonitor.kt) —
carry no `catch` either. A raise from any of these upstream sources
(`RaceRepositoryImpl.observeAll`/`observeReference`,
`ProfileRepositoryImpl.observe`, or the Room `Flow` under them) takes its
`ViewModel`'s `viewModelScope` down, since nothing there installs a
`CoroutineExceptionHandler`.

## Expected

Closing `PayloadCodec.decodeRecordedRace`/`decodeProfileSync` and the
`serviceScope.launch` blocks that follow them, in both listener services,
wraps the call site and returns/logs a failure instead of raising — the
pattern `ExerciseSessionSystemImpl.startExerciseSession` already follows,
and `serviceScope` in each service carries a `CoroutineExceptionHandler` so
an escape from the launched coroutine no longer reaches the default handler.

The same treatment is required, as part of the same fix, at every other
boundary and collection point the code shows to carry none:

- `RaceRepositoryImpl` and `ProfileRepositoryImpl` (`:core-data`) catch what
  each `raceDao`/`profileDao` call can raise and return it through the
  `Result<T>` their interfaces already declare, instead of letting it
  propagate.
- `RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.markSegment` (`:app-wear`) guards the
  `profileRepository.observe().first()` read the same way.
- Each of the seven `collect` sites in `:app-wear`
  (`HomeViewModel`, `PreparationViewModel`, `WatchHistoryViewModel`,
  `WaitingForPhoneViewModel`) and the two link-state collectors
  (`HomeViewModel`, `app-phone`'s `ProfileViewModel`) attach a `.catch`
  operator on the flow they collect, defining what the screen does when its
  source fails, instead of letting the raise take the `ViewModel`'s scope
  down.
- Every scope that launches work not bounded by a caller — both
  `serviceScope`s and each `viewModelScope` — installs a
  `CoroutineExceptionHandler`, so an exception that still escapes a guarded
  call site is logged rather than reaching the process-wide default handler.
